title: General Posting Setup card or alternative route discovery
purpose: Find a materially different, screenshot-proven Page 314 route for the INLAND/WAREN/4400/5400 General Posting Setup row after List Edit/New and Ctrl+Insert failed to expose editable inputs.

smartDecision.whyNow: The exact matrix row blocks W1 Foundation, but TARGET-032D proved the list-new route is not safe because no editable inputs appear.
sourceBackedBy: TARGET-032D result and screenshots show no trusted editable row after Edit List/New.
TARGET-032D Ctrl+Insert fallback also produced no trusted editable inputs.
Microsoft Learn describes General Posting Setup as combinations that can be maintained line-by-line; a line/card or alternate setup route is plausible but not yet proven in this UI.
smartDecision.risk: Repeating the empty list-new route wastes time and could tempt blind typing. A new route must be identified before values are entered.
smartDecision.fallback: If no card/action/personalization/page-inspection route is found, park Page 314 and decide whether VAT/Dimensions can proceed with an explicit boundary.

entryCriteria: TARGET-032D result exists and is reviewed.
No setup values were typed in TARGET-032D.
Page 314 is still the active setup blocker.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central stays in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A materially different Page 314 route is identified or the blocker is parked with reason.
Screenshots explain the route or blocked action surface.
No setup value, master data, draft, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment or API shortcut occurs.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-032C trusted header geometry, but TARGET-032D showed that visible Edit List/New and Ctrl+Insert still do not reveal editable inputs.
nextStepDecision.reason: Repeating the same List New route would waste time and risk unsafe blind typing. The best next step is a materially different Page 314 route discovery.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Required because the list-new route is blocked and no values were written.
Dimensions should wait until Page 314 is either solved or consciously parked.
Foundation cannot be ready while the General Posting Setup matrix row is unresolved.
Master data remains locked until posting groups, VAT and dimensions are sufficient.

queueChangesMade: Replaced repeated TARGET-032D execution with TARGET-032E alternative route discovery.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It attacks the actual blocker with a new UI hypothesis instead of repeating New/Edit/keyboard-new on the empty matrix list.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not type 4400/5400 without trusted inputs.
Do not create master data, Preview Posting or Posting.
requiredPreparation: Review TARGET-032D screenshots and field-plan JSON before selecting a new Page 314 route.
